'''Fudbalski klub Famos Vojkovići''' ([[Serbian Cyrillic alphabet|Serbian Cyrillic]]: Фудбалски клуб Фамос Војковићи) is a [[football (soccer)|football]] [[football club|club]] from the [[Vojkovići (Istočno Sarajevo)|Vojkovići]], part of the City of [[Istočno Sarajevo]] in [[Republika Srpska]], [[Bosnia and Herzegovina]].

The club competes in the second tier-[[First League of the Republika Srpska]]. Their neighbors from the community of Hrasnica in [[Ilidža]] are only 3,5 kilometers away and called [[FK Famos Hrasnica|Famos Hrasnica]]."}}
